doc_friction.issue: A foreground --timeout 110 wait just times out; the backgrounded wait is the only workable pattern for a 20-minute job, which the CLAUDE.md text already says but costs one try.
The stop hook flagged untracked files while a long background run was writing its log; gitignoring run.log and __pycache__ in the experiment directory avoided it.

notes: Research track, programme verifiable-training-mechanisms milestone 91. Pre-registered 60 float32 arbiter threshold rules and a selection criterion (worst-zone conviction of one forged float16 step) before generating data; 2,560 runs (calibration 100-179, selection 200-239, holdout 300-339). Selected 10x zone 0.95 quantile on 80 calibration seeds; on the holdout every momentum/Adam zone convicts f16_1 at 1.000 (old rule's worst zones 0 and 0.095), 13 of 48,000 honest convictions; SGD's last zone stays at 0.22-0.36. T1-T8 all held. certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
